response.sql: WITH p AS (SELECT ID, AVG(HGB) AS a FROM Laboratory GROUP BY ID HAVING AVG(HGB) IS NOT NULL), o AS (SELECT AVG(HGB) AS m FROM Laboratory), s AS (SELECT p.ID, p.a, p.a - o.m AS above FROM p, o WHERE p.a > o.m) SELECT ID, a AS avg_hgb, above AS above_overall, a - (SELECT AVG(a) FROM s) AS diff_from_group_avg FROM s ORDER BY diff_from_group_avg DESC LIMIT 10
